in_sanskrit.name: अजेय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who cannot be conquered or vanquished.

in_hindi.name: अजेय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अजेय होना अथवा विजयी होना चाहता हुआ अपना शक्ति और संतुष्ट रहना चाहता हुआ श्रेष्ठ और अपने दिवस को अजेय के रूप में समझना चाहता हुआ है। (Ajeeya hona apna shakti aur santusht rahna chahta hua shresth aur apne divas ko Ajeya ke roop mein samjhna chahta hua hai.)

in_tamil.name: அஜேய
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is free from all obstacles and difficulties.

in_telugu.name: అజేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is supreme in all aspects and invincible.

in_marathi.name: Ajeya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajeya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ajeya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aj’ which means 'not' and ‘iya’ which means 'conqueror' or 'invincible'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu tradition to signify strength and invincibility.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Ajeya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Ajeya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aj’ which means 'not' and ‘iya’ which means 'conqueror' or 'invincible'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu tradition to signify strength and invincibility.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Ajeya' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aj' meaning 'not' and 'iya' meaning 'go'. This name is also associated with Lord Rama, who was invincible and unconquerable due to his devotion to Lord Vishnu.
